thread:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — Halifax (Enterprise, CSM=Tom) logged three recurring asks during onboarding call: per-route billing toggle, more prompt templates for short-context embeddings, and clearer quota visibility in the console. They said this is blocking rollout to ~20 internal teams.

maria_pm: Thanks. Can you paste examples + approximate freq? We'll need impact, effort estimate, and whether this is a renewal blocker.

elaine_cs: Example snippets below. Frequency: ~5 asks across 3 customers this month (Halifax, NovaHealth, Brightline). They keep hitting cost predictability per-route and can't find quota in Console.

nora_support: I have the support threads + screen recordings. Adding links in the ticket I just opened: https://support.example.com/tickets/HT-3245

ben_research: Quick prioritization thought: score by (revenue_at_risk * request_freq) / dev_days. Per-route billing = high revenue impact, medium effort. Prompt templates = low dev, high UX value. Quota visibility = medium revenue, low effort.

sam_pdm: Can someone drop 1-line descriptions for each ask so I can sketch PRD stubs? Also flag any compliance/security concerns.

elaine_cs: per-route billing toggle: "Customer needs ability to opt certain routes to be billed at dedicated vs hosted rates to avoid cross-charge spikes."
prompt templates: "Prebuilt short-context embeddings templates and examples (e.g., product search, faq-match) to reduce time-to-proof."
quota visibility: "Dashboard card + alerting when route-level token usage > 80% of quota; ability to drill into top routes."

maria_pm: OK. Sam, Ben — can you two give rough T-shirt sizes by EOD? I'll create one ticket per ask and link CS threads. @nora_support please attach transcripts and videos.

jira-bot: Created RED-PRD-491 (per-route-billing), RED-PRD-492 (prompt-templates), RED-PRD-493 (quota-visibility). Linked: HT-3245.

nora_support: :thumbsup: attaching video + chat export to those tickets now.

sam_pdm: T-shirt sizes: per-route billing = L (3w), prompt templates = S (3d), quota visibility = M (1w).

ben_research: I'll pull frequency counts from the ticket corpus and drop a CSV in /shared/cs/feedback/ by tomorrow. Quick sample:
```
customer,ask,freq,last_seen
Halifax,per-route-billing,3,2026-03-15
NovaHealth,prompt-templates,2,2026-03-12
Brightline,quota-visibility,1,2026-03-10
```

elaine_cs: Next steps — Maria to confirm roadmap fit; Sam to own PRDs; Nora to attach materials; Ben to add freq metrics. If needed, sync Tues 10am. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
